reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Good pain is the burn and fatigue of a muscle working hard, the kind that shows up during a set or the day after and fades within a few days. Bad pain is sharp, sudden, sits in a joint, makes you change how you move, or is still there the next morning or getting worse. Bad pain means stop that movement and get it checked by a doctor or physio, not pushed through. Any doubt, treat it as bad pain."}
